$comment: Template: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN} is substituted at render time. Produce a submittable manifest with `python scripts/render_manifests.py --env prod` (or --env dev), or fetch the rendered document from a running server at GET /manifests/claude_connector.json, which fills in the origin it was reached on.
name: financial-portfolios-ai
description: Connect Claude to Financial Portfolios AI to analyze quantitative portfolios, inspect target asset allocations, calculate rebalancing alignment arithmetic, and read institutional market research. Subscribers see the live book; other signed-in users see the public book delayed by ~45 days. (Informational only under publisher exclusion; not individualized financial advice).

streamable_http.description: Recommended remote Streamable HTTP transport for Claude Connectors on web & cloud

stdio.description: Standard I/O transport for local Claude Desktop and Claude Code CLI

authentication.instructions: Add this server as a custom connector in Claude (Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector), paste the server URL, and sign in when prompted - OAuth 2.1, no API key to paste. Command-line clients (Claude Code, local stdio) instead pass a personal token via the X-API-Key header.

oauth2.description: A tokenless request to /mcp is answered with 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=... (RFC 9728), which is what starts the sign-in flow in Claude.

api_key.description: For command-line and local stdio clients, which do not run the OAuth flow: generate a personal token at Settings > API Tokens and pass it as X-API-Key (or as FINANCIAL_PORTFOLIOS_API_TOKEN for stdio).

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description: List every active quantitative investment portfolio (e.g. AQA_AGGRESSIVE, AQA_BALANCED, AQA_DEFENSIVE), each marked access = subscribed (live book) or public_delayed (holdings delayed ~45 days).

tools.name: get_portfolio_allocation
tools.description: Retrieve a target allocation snapshot: the latest book with expected returns and risk metrics for subscribed portfolios, or the public book delayed ~45 days (ticker/weight/sector only) otherwise. Response carries access, delayed, as_of and lag_days.

tools.name: get_portfolio_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical allocation snapshots over a custom time window (up to 365 days). Non-subscribers receive only entries at or before today - 45 days, with null allocation metrics.

tools.name: rebalance_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate mathematical target-model alignment arithmetic (share quantity differences) given user holdings (max 200 rows, 512 KB). Requires an active subscription covering the target portfolio.

tools.name: get_rebalance_template
tools.description: Download the standard CSV template format and guidelines for uploading user portfolio holdings.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Search and list published quantitative research articles, market updates, and investment commentaries.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieve full content of a published research article by slug.

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Inspect active API token metadata, usage rate limits, and subscription status.

prompts.name: portfolio_review
prompts.description: Comprehensive portfolio analysis prompt to evaluate asset allocation, risk profile, and position weights.

prompts.name: rebalance_advisor
prompts.description: Guided assistant prompt for calculating and reviewing model alignment arithmetic for user holdings.

prompts.name: market_research_digest
prompts.description: Synthesizes recent quantitative research articles and market commentaries into an executive summary.
